Class

Algebra 2

Explore Algebra 2 through jump trajectories, suspension, speed and performance data: the same functions engineers and coaches use to describe how bikes and riders behave.

9 units · 42 topics · activities in development

Units

  1. Unit 1 Equations and Inequalities 5 topics

    1. Linear Equations Review

      Solve linear equations and inequalities fluently, including literal equations.

      • Solve multi-step linear equations
      • Solve linear inequalities
      • Rearrange formulas for a variable
      Activities in development

    2. Absolute Value Equations

      Solve |ax + b| = c and related inequalities by splitting into cases.

      • Solve absolute value equations
      • Solve absolute value inequalities
      • Model tolerances with absolute value
      Activities in development

    3. Complex Numbers

      Work with i = √−1: add, subtract, multiply and divide complex numbers.

      • Simplify powers of i and square roots of negatives
      • Add, subtract and multiply complex numbers
      • Divide complex numbers using conjugates
      Activities in development

    4. Radical Equations

      Solve equations with square roots and other radicals, checking for extraneous solutions.

      • Isolate the radical and raise both sides to a power
      • Identify extraneous solutions
      • Solve equations with rational exponents
      Activities in development

    5. Rational Equations

      Solve equations with variable denominators by clearing fractions.

      • Solve by multiplying by the least common denominator
      • Find excluded values and extraneous solutions
      • Solve work-rate problems
      Activities in development
  2. Unit 2 Functions 5 topics

    1. Function Notation

      Use and interpret f(x), including piecewise functions.

      • Evaluate functions, including piecewise functions
      • Interpret function notation in context
      • Write and graph piecewise functions
      Activities in development

    2. Domain and Range

      Find domain and range for a variety of functions, using interval notation.

      • Find domain restrictions (division by zero, even roots)
      • Find range from a graph
      • Use interval notation
      Activities in development

    3. Transformations of Functions

      Shift, stretch, compress and reflect graphs: y = a f(b(x − h)) + k.

      • Shift graphs vertically and horizontally
      • Stretch, compress and reflect graphs
      • Describe a transformation from an equation
      Activities in development

    4. Inverse Functions

      Find and graph inverses, and decide when a function has one.

      • Find the inverse of a function
      • Verify inverses by composition
      • Decide whether an inverse is a function
      Activities in development

    5. Composite Functions

      Combine functions by composition, f(g(x)), and by arithmetic.

      • Evaluate and simplify composite functions
      • Write a function as a composition
      • Add, subtract, multiply and divide functions
      Activities in development
  3. Unit 3 Linear Systems and Matrices 4 topics

    1. Systems of Equations

      Solve and interpret systems of two equations, including nonlinear ones.

      • Solve two-variable systems by any method
      • Solve linear–quadratic systems
      • Graph systems of inequalities
      Activities in development

    2. Three-Variable Systems

      Solve systems of three linear equations in three unknowns.

      • Reduce a three-variable system to two variables
      • Solve three-variable systems
      • Model situations with three unknowns
      Activities in development

    3. Matrix Operations

      Add, subtract, scale and multiply matrices; find determinants and inverses of 2×2 matrices.

      • Add, subtract and scale matrices
      • Multiply matrices
      • Find a 2×2 determinant and inverse
      Activities in development

    4. Applications of Matrices

      Use matrices to organize data and solve systems.

      • Solve systems with matrix equations
      • Use matrices to organize and combine data
      • Represent transformations with matrices
      Activities in development
  4. Unit 4 Quadratic Functions 5 topics

    1. Quadratic Graphs

      Graph quadratics in standard, vertex and factored form, and connect each form to features.

      • Graph quadratics from standard, vertex and factored form
      • Identify vertex, axis, intercepts and direction
      • Write a quadratic from features or points
      Activities in development

    2. Vertex Form

      y = a(x − h)² + k: read and use the vertex directly.

      • Read the vertex and direction from vertex form
      • Write a quadratic in vertex form
      • Use vertex form to solve problems
      Activities in development

    3. Completing the Square

      Rewrite quadratics in vertex form and solve equations by completing the square.

      • Complete the square
      • Convert standard form to vertex form
      • Solve equations by completing the square
      Activities in development

    4. Quadratic Formula

      Solve with the quadratic formula and connect it to completing the square.

      • Solve with the quadratic formula
      • Use the discriminant
      • Solve projectile problems for time
      Activities in development

    5. Complex Solutions

      Find and interpret complex solutions of quadratic equations.

      • Find complex solutions with the quadratic formula
      • Recognize conjugate pairs
      • Explain what complex roots mean for a graph
      Activities in development
  5. Unit 5 Polynomial Functions 5 topics

    1. Polynomial Operations

      Add, subtract, multiply and divide polynomials, including long and synthetic division.

      • Add, subtract and multiply polynomials
      • Divide polynomials using long division
      • Use synthetic division
      Activities in development

    2. Polynomial Graphs

      Sketch polynomial graphs from degree, leading coefficient, zeros and multiplicity.

      • Determine end behavior
      • Use zeros and multiplicity to sketch graphs
      • Find the maximum number of turning points
      Activities in development

    3. Factoring Higher-Degree Polynomials

      Factor cubics and quartics using grouping, patterns and known factors.

      • Factor sums and differences of cubes
      • Factor polynomials in quadratic form
      • Factor using a known root
      Activities in development

    4. Roots and Zeros

      Find real and complex zeros; use the rational root theorem and the fundamental theorem of algebra.

      • List possible rational roots
      • Find all zeros of a polynomial
      • Use the fundamental theorem of algebra
      Activities in development

    5. Remainder and Factor Theorems

      Use P(a) to find remainders and test factors.

      • Use the remainder theorem
      • Use the factor theorem to test factors
      • Write a polynomial from its zeros
      Activities in development
  6. Unit 6 Rational and Radical Functions 5 topics

    1. Rational Expressions

      Simplify, multiply, divide, add and subtract rational expressions.

      • Simplify rational expressions
      • Multiply and divide rational expressions
      • Add and subtract with unlike denominators
      Activities in development

    2. Rational Equations

      Solve rational equations and use them to model rates, averages and inverse variation.

      • Solve rational equations
      • Model inverse variation
      • Solve average-speed and rate problems
      Activities in development

    3. Radical Functions

      Graph square-root and cube-root functions and their transformations.

      • Graph square- and cube-root functions
      • Transform radical graphs
      • Find domain and range of radical functions
      Activities in development

    4. Graphing Rational Functions

      Sketch rational functions using intercepts, asymptotes and holes.

      • Find intercepts and holes
      • Sketch rational functions
      • Transform y = 1/x
      Activities in development

    5. Asymptotes

      Find vertical, horizontal and slant asymptotes and explain behavior near them.

      • Find vertical asymptotes
      • Find horizontal asymptotes from degrees
      • Find slant asymptotes
      Activities in development
  7. Unit 7 Exponential and Logarithmic Functions 5 topics

    1. Exponential Functions

      Graph y = abˣ, including base e, and describe asymptotes and growth.

      • Graph exponential functions
      • Use the natural base e
      • Transform exponential graphs
      Activities in development

    2. Exponential Growth and Decay

      Model growth and decay, including compound and continuous interest.

      • Write growth and decay models
      • Use compound and continuous interest formulas
      • Compare exponential and linear models
      Activities in development

    3. Logarithms

      Understand logarithms as inverses of exponentials; convert between forms and evaluate.

      • Convert between logarithmic and exponential form
      • Evaluate logarithms
      • Graph logarithmic functions
      Activities in development

    4. Logarithmic Properties

      Use product, quotient and power properties and change of base.

      • Expand and condense logarithms
      • Use change of base
      • Solve exponential and logarithmic equations
      Activities in development

    5. Applications

      Use exponential and logarithmic models: half-life, doubling time, pH, decibels.

      • Find doubling time and half-life
      • Interpret logarithmic scales
      • Fit exponential models to data
      Activities in development
  8. Unit 8 Sequences and Series 4 topics

    1. Arithmetic Sequences

      Sequences with a common difference: explicit and recursive rules.

      • Find the common difference and next terms
      • Write the explicit rule aₙ = a₁ + (n − 1)d
      • Write a recursive rule
      Activities in development

    2. Geometric Sequences

      Sequences with a common ratio.

      • Find the common ratio and next terms
      • Write aₙ = a₁rⁿ⁻¹
      • Decide whether a sequence is arithmetic, geometric or neither
      Activities in development

    3. Series

      Add the terms of arithmetic and geometric sequences, including infinite geometric series.

      • Find sums of arithmetic series
      • Find sums of finite geometric series
      • Decide when an infinite geometric series converges, and find its sum
      Activities in development

    4. Summation Notation

      Read and write sums with sigma notation.

      • Expand and evaluate sums in sigma notation
      • Write a series in sigma notation
      • Use properties of sums
      Activities in development
  9. Unit 9 Probability and Statistics 4 topics

    1. Probability

      Find probabilities of single and compound events, including independent events.

      • Find theoretical and experimental probabilities
      • Find probabilities of compound events
      • Decide whether events are independent
      Activities in development

    2. Conditional Probability

      Find P(A | B) from tables and diagrams.

      • Use two-way tables
      • Use P(A | B) = P(A and B) / P(B)
      • Interpret conditional probabilities
      Activities in development

    3. Combinations and Permutations

      Count arrangements and selections.

      • Use the fundamental counting principle
      • Count permutations
      • Count combinations
      Activities in development

    4. Statistical Analysis

      Use the normal distribution, sampling and margin of error to draw conclusions.

      • Use the normal distribution and z-scores
      • Evaluate sampling methods and bias
      • Interpret margin of error
      Activities in development
